name: StoneVault permissionless round settlement
summary: StoneVault's round-advance entry point (selector 0x5069fb57) had no access control, so the attacker could deposit, settle the round themselves at a share price they had just moved, and withdraw at a profit in the same transaction.
notes: The direct StoneVault runtime was created by this transaction and remained unchanged through the exploit.
The trace records 8,600 ETH deposited into StoneVault and 8,617.073005336909691789 ETH withdrawn after the attacker advanced the round, for an exact vault net loss of 17.073005336909691789 ETH.
